hooks.hook: Your brain twitches your muscles because it thinks you are dying.
hooks.why: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri You/Your da'vosi tomoshabinda darhol kuchli qiziqish uyg'otadi.

hooks.hook: Watch your body jerk awake next time you drift into sleep.
hooks.why: Tomoshabinni o'z tanasidagi universal refleksni darhol kuzatishga undaydi.

hooks.hook: Seventy percent of people violently jerk awake from a fake fall.
hooks.why: Aniq raqam orqali bu sirli holat tomoshabinning o'ziga ham tegishli ekanini ko'rsatadi.

hooks.hook: You feel like you're falling, but your muscles are only relaxing.
hooks.why: Miya hissi va haqiqiy tana holati o'rtasidagi ziddiyat e'tiborni tortadi.

hooks.hook: Why does your body violently twitch right before you fall asleep?
hooks.why: Klassik savol shakli orqali keng tarqalgan tana siriga qiziqish uyg'otadi.

hooks.hook: Your brain secretly shocks your body every time you fall asleep.
hooks.why: Kutilmagan kuchli fakt kanalning g'olib da'vo formulasiga to'liq mos keladi.
